## Summary

Based on my assessment of your circumstances, **you are currently ineligible for Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake**.

### For Alex (8 years old):
You cannot yet claim Child Benefit because Alex has not come to live with you yet. While the good news is that you don't have to wait for the adoption process to be complete, you can only claim Child Benefit from the point when Alex actually comes to live with you. Once Alex moves in with you, you will be able to claim Child Benefit at that time.

### For Blake (9 years old):
Although Blake lives with you and is under 16, another person in your household has priority to claim Child Benefit for Blake. Only one person can receive Child Benefit for the same child, so you cannot claim while someone else has priority.

**What you can do:**
- **For Alex:** You will be able to claim Child Benefit as soon as Alex comes to live with you as part of the adoption process
- **For Blake:** If circumstances change and you want to become the claimant, you and the other person would need to agree on who should claim, or you could contact the Child Benefit Office for guidance

If you have any questions or if your circumstances change, please don't hesitate to ask!
